statement: CarDiv5 uses distributed radar/lookout->plot/air-control->shotai/chutai-leader voice control; no modern FDO/GCI claim.
First-line CarDiv5 A6M radio fit treated as standard operational equipment; COM2 normal when serviceable, but faults/congestion remain.
A6M defense differentiated into HIGH/MID/LOW/READY-RELIEF by task/fuel/readiness; roles are not permanent clean layers.
Controller can maintain recent shotai/chutai sector/task/status estimates via leader reports, not individual aircraft coordinates/energy/ammo.
CMD2 normal; CMD3 group-level sector/task control achievable pre/early contact, degrades under dense merge; no precision GCI.
Use D3 group discipline -> D2 shotai -> D1 local -> D0 fragmented transitions; better comms slow collapse but do not prevent pursuit/dogpile.
Do not commit all fighters to first sighted group; retain unresolved-threat/high/local reserve when possible.
Radio gain acts through task preservation/relief/less duplicate chase, not generic kill multiplier; fighter-count sensitivity is nonlinear.
Run A14/A16/A18 through warning->CAP->COM/CMD/D transitions->F4F/SBD/TBD->AA to valid-release bands only; stop before hits.
